[AI engineering](../index.qmd) / Product and field engineering

Translate a real workflow into a useful system people can understand, evaluate and adopt.

## What to understand

- **Discovery:** understand the user’s work, existing tools, constraints and the cost of mistakes.
- **Scoping:** choose one measurable task, establish a baseline and agree what success means.
- **Integration:** customer data, identity, existing APIs and the gap between a demo and a deployed workflow.
- **Interaction design:** citations, editable outputs, progress, uncertainty, confirmation and recovery.
- **Adoption:** handoffs, documentation, feedback, change management and operational ownership.
- **Decision records:** what changed, why, evidence, tradeoffs and when to reconsider.

## How the pieces connect

FDE means forward-deployed engineering: working close to users to deliver an integrated system. It draws on the whole map, not only model expertise.

## A question to test

Write a one-page task brief, show a working example to a user, and record whether it improves their work. Separate user evidence from your own design assumptions.
